messages:
tasha: Heads-up: onboarding hit a weird one. Our sample app kept authenticating as the old PROJECT key after ops injected an ORG key into the pod env. Long-lived websocket streams kept the old principal alive. Anyone seen SDKs prefer on-disk creds over env rotation?
omar: ouch. which SDK and how are you doing the rotation?
tasha: repro in our case:
```
# image baked with proj key or init writes it
export REDWOOD_API_KEY_PROJECT=proj-old-aaa
# later k8s sidecar or controller injects ORG key into pod env
export REDWOOD_API_KEY_ORG=org-new-bbb
# start service
./run-sampleapp
```
Requests still show proj-old-aaa.
li: sounds like a credential cache issue. older sdks drop a file at ~/.redwood/credentials and client init reads that and prefers it. If the file exists before the env changes, the process won't pick up the new env key.
corey: confirmed: our go sdk had file > env precedence pre-2.0. We also had code that created the cache lazily on first auth. That explains streams reconnecting with the old identity.
other: (typo)
omar: UX options: (1) make env always win, (2) warn loudly when env and cache disagree, (3) provide an explicit cache-invalidate API or SIGHUP behavior. Backcompat is tricky.
tasha: mitigation for now: we added an init step in the container to remove ~/.redwood/credentials if REDWOOD_API_KEY_* present. Not ideal but low risk.
li: agree on docs + test. Add an e2e in sampleapp CI that asserts identity flips after env rotation. Also add a CLI/SDK one-line warning: `WARN: env REDWOOD_API_KEY_* differs from cached credentials (~/.redwood/credentials). Environment will be used but cached file may be stale.`
corey: can someone open an RFC/issue with compatibility plan? For 1.x: warn + doc. For 2.x: flip precedence to env > file and provide explicit migration notes.
tasha: filed DEVEX-4721 and linked sampleapp repro logs: https://intern.redwood/issue/DEVEX-4721. tagging @eng-runtime and @devex.
devex-bot: Created issue DEVEX-4721: "Credential precedence during env rotation causing stale principal on long-lived streams" and linked to redwood/sdk and sampleapp repos.
omar: assigning work: @li for RFC + SDK PR (warning + unit test), @corey add e2e rotation test in sampleapp CI, @tasha update quickstart onboarding note to warn about baked credentials in containers.
li: will draft PR that logs the warning and documents behavior. For 2.x we should add an opt-in env var REDWOOD_CRED_PREFERENCE=env to opt in early.
tasha: thanks all, saved us from a 3am pager. :relieved:
